headline: Gold Rebounds From One-Year Low as AI Jitters Ease and Dollar Lulls
summary: Spot gold climbed 1.6% to $3,622.91 per ounce, rebounding from a one-year low as a US holiday lull calmed AI-driven market jitters and eased selling pressure.
why: Gold serves as a primary global safe-haven asset, reacting immediately to shifts in US inflation data, interest rate expectations, and broader equity market volatility.
why_moved: A US holiday lull and easing AI jitters reduced liquidation pressure, prompting a rebound from multi-month lows driven by hot US inflation data.
